subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS-only population by inclusion criterion. BMI not reported so obesity subgroup unclear. Timing measured only from enrolment into the protocol sequence, so timing subgroup unclear per codebook ruling. PTP target is absolute end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure 3 ± 2 cmH2O via absolute Pes subtraction. ICU mortality is the only mortality reported and is therefore the longest reported mortality.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any cluster in COHORTS.md. Registration NCT02416037 is unique to this report; enrolment January 2016 to March 2017 at Hôpital de la Croix-Rousse, Lyon, France and Sant Pau Hospital, Barcelona, Spain does not match any listed cluster (EPVent trials were Boston-based; Boesing Mannheim; Fumagalli/Florio MGH; Angers). No shared cohort identified.
unclear_items: design.randomised: the early PEEP strategy application was explicitly not randomised, but the late prone phase was randomly allocated; recorded as null since the design as a whole is a non-randomised physiologic protocol with a randomised component
population.ards_definition_used: ARDS diagnosis definition (Berlin or other) not stated in the report
population.ards_severity.mild and severe: only 33 primary ARDS and 26 moderate ARDS reported; severity distribution incomplete (26 moderate of 38, remainder not classifiable from the text)

feasibility.n_placement_attempted and n_placement_successful: inferred as 38 from the statement that Pes was recorded with verification of correct placement in all enrolled patients; no explicit placement success count given
population.n_analysed: set equal to n_enrolled (38) as the paper reports analyses on 37-38 patients per table with varying denominators; no single analysed n stated
outcomes mortality data: ICU mortality reported only for the whole cohort (14/38); no per-arm mortality breakdown available
intervention.timing: timing relative to intubation or ARDS onset not reported; protocol steps begin at enrolment
data_only_in_figure: Individual values of Pes,ee and PL,ee in supine and prone positions (Fig. 1)
Variation of PEEP with Pes-guided strategy in supine and prone position (Fig. 2)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Within-patient physiologic study with four early crossover conditions (supine/prone × PEEP/FIO2 table/Pes-guided) plus a randomised late-prone phase (19 per strategy, 17 analysed in Pes-guided late prone). Table 1 reports the four early conditions; Table 2 reports early vs late prone by strategy. Only a subset of Table 1/2 rows recorded as outcomes; the full tables contain additional rows (Paw,ee, Paw,ei, Pes,ei, Pga,ee, Pga,ei, PL,ei, PL,ei_Elastance, DPrs, DPcw, PaCO2) available in the source. Mortality reported only as a cohort-level count (14/38, 37%) during ICU stay; no per-arm breakdown. EIT regional compliance data (Table 3) not extracted as outcomes due to incomplete denominators across conditions.
